UnitStatement: Rider test coverage for TP-SEAM-CORPUS-001: when the mechanics result summary lacks location references, the Local FEA handoff package must emit an explicit incomplete-state finding and degrade honestly, never inventing fixture entity references.
The former pipe:P-120 / node:N-140 fixture fallback references must not be invented as substitutes; all fixture data in the test is invented.
inventedModel() builds a PreviewModel test fixture with project units length=m, force=N, angle=rad, pressure=Pa, temperature=degC and analysis_status mechanics=ready.
inventedResult(summary) builds a MechanicsResult fixture with status mechanics=MECHANICS_SOLVED, rule_check=not_performed, professional_acceptance=not_provided.
inventedAnalysisRun() builds an AnalysisRunEnvelope fixture whose immutability_policy marks run records read-only, requires a new run for change, and invalidates external acceptance on hash change.
exportedPacket() reads the local-fea-export-link href data URL and returns the decoded handoff JSON payload string.
Test: when summary location refs are missing, the panel region shows local-region:stress-location-ref-missing:displacement-location-ref-missing with nodes=0, elements=0, and diagnostics=5.

Test: the exported packet contains LOCAL-FEA-RESULT-SUMMARY-REF-MISSING and the missing summary.max_open_formula_stress.location_ref and summary.max_displacement.location_ref fields, with no invented substitute references.

Test: when the summary carries location refs (max_displacement at node:N-2, max_open_formula_stress at pipe:P-1), the panel keeps the four standing findings, shows diagnostics=4, and the packet omits the REF-MISSING finding.
Type LocalFeaReference: a reference with ref_id, ref_kind, locator, path_is_user_supplied flag, and optional content_hash checksum.
Type LocalFeaChecksum: algorithm (sha256|sha512|TBD), canonicalization (JCS-compatible-json|external-file-native|none|TBD), payload_ref, and value.
Constant LOCAL_FEA_HANDOFF_VERSION = 0.1.0; HASH_STATUS_TBD declares the browser preview does not emit a local FEA package hash.
LocalFeaHandoffPanel(model, result, analysisRun) is a React panel that builds the local FEA handoff packet only when both result and analysisRun are present.

When no packet exists, the panel prompts the user to run the mechanics preview to assemble a target-neutral local shell/solid FEA handoff package with selected region, transfer-basis references, advisory labels, and explicit TBD flags.

Panel note: local FEA handoff output is target-neutral review context only; no mesh, external solver, target format, approval, authentication, certification, sealing, or code-compliance claim is generated.
buildLocalFeaHandoffPacket(model, result, analysisRun) assembles the local FEA handoff packet from the selected region, selected result refs, diagnostics, and run hashes.
The handoff packet declares deliverable_id DEL-10-03, package_id PKG-10, scope_items SOW-031 and SOW-049, and objective OBJ-009.

contract_status: contract_kind=schema_first_local_fea_handoff_contract; global role is primary global centerline frame model; local role is optional specialized shell/solid handoff; export format, solver adapter, mesh generation, and external solver invocation are TBD; professional_decision=human_review_required.

local_region selection_basis is diagnostic_suggested and carries selected entity ids, geometry refs, local detail refs, a global-preview coordinate system ref, and reason_labels including human_review_required.

guidance_assessment labels include local_detail_review_consider, local_shell_solid_handoff_consider, global_to_local_transfer_inputs_incomplete, and human_review_required, with all approval/compliance/certification/sealing claim flags false.
Handoff package privacy: local_only=true, telemetry_allowed=false, private_payload_embedded=false, classification=public_metadata_only, redaction_required_before_public_export=true.

selectedLocalRegion(model, result): no invented fallback references; when the result summary lacks a location_ref, the absence is surfaced as LOCAL-FEA-RESULT-SUMMARY-REF-MISSING and the region degrades honestly instead of borrowing fixture ids.
The region_id is composed from the stress element token (or stress-location-ref-missing) and the displacement node token (or displacement-location-ref-missing).
entityIds() returns the namespaced entity id set: component_ids, node_ids, element_ids, station_ids, load_case_ids, and result_ids for the selected region.
selectedResultRefs(result) gathers preferred result refs (max_displacement, max_open_formula_stress, and example force/moment/stress refs) filtered to those actually available in the result.
Diagnostic LOCAL-FEA-MESH-NOT-GENERATED (LOCAL_HANDOFF_WARNING): mesh generation is not performed by the desktop technical preview.
Diagnostic LOCAL-FEA-TARGET-FORMAT-TBD (LOCAL_HANDOFF_WARNING): the concrete local FEA exchange format and target solver adapter remain TBD.
Diagnostic LOCAL-FEA-BOUNDARY-TRANSFER-REVIEW (LOCAL_HANDOFF_WARNING): boundary transfer is represented by result references only and requires human review.
Diagnostic LOCAL-FEA-EXTERNAL-SOLVER-NOT-INVOKED (EXPORT_BLOCKING): no external shell or solid FEA solver is invoked by this package; external execution remains user-owned.
Diagnostic LOCAL-FEA-RESULT-SUMMARY-REF-MISSING is appended (after the four standing findings) when result summary location refs are missing, stating no substitute entity references are invented.

unsupportedBehaviorFlags maps diagnostics to flags: mesh_generation_not_performed, target_format_not_selected, boundary_transfer_requires_review, local_detail_assumption_unresolved, and external_solver_not_invoked.
unitsManifest(model) derives the local FEA handoff unit manifest with moment_unit N*m, displacement_unit mm, rotation_unit rad, and stress/temperature units defaulting from the model project units.
reference(refKind, locator, pathIsUserSupplied=false) constructs a LocalFeaReference with a safe ref_id token.
professionalBoundary() declares human_review_required=true and all compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication claim flags false.
safeRefToken/safeFileToken sanitize values to safe token strings, returning a default ('ref'/'preview') when empty.
Type GuiWarningClass enumerates SOLVE_BLOCKING, RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, PROVENANCE_WARNING, ASSUMPTION_WARNING, NONLINEAR_WARNING, and IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING.

Type MissingDataWarning carries warning_id, warning_class, local_contract_class, severity, analysis_status, affected/source refs, message, remediation, and flags blocks_mechanics_solve, blocks_rule_check, qualifies_mechanics_results, private_data_required, protected_content_required.
MissingDataBlockingPanel(model, result) renders a missing-data blocking review panel from the built missing-data blocking packet.

Panel note: missing-data warnings distinguish mechanics solve readiness from user-rule checking; they do not fill missing engineering values and do not certify, approve, seal, authenticate, or declare code compliance.
buildMissingDataBlockingPacket(model, result) merges model and result diagnostics, separates mechanics/rule_check/professional_acceptance status inputs, and builds the warning set.

The missing-data packet declares document_kind openpipestress.technical_preview.missing_data_warning_blocking_review, deliverable DEL-07-04, package PKG-07, scope SOW-022, objectives OBJ-006 and OBJ-011.

Packet summary distinguishes mechanics_results_reviewable from mechanics_results_qualified_by_rule_inputs, and asserts silent_defaults_used=false, bundled_code_values_used=false, compliance_claim_made=false.
analysis_boundary_contract authority_model is mechanics_rule_human_acceptance_separated with human_acceptance_record_policy=external_hash_bound_human_record_only.
assistive_contract requires text fields class, severity, affected_refs, message, remediation, and forbids color-only signaling.
source_of_truth_boundary: the GUI is not source of truth; mutation route is diagnostic_display_only_no_model_defaulting; direct model mutation and accepted model state mutation are not allowed.
buildWarnings() constructs the active MissingDataWarning list from model/result status and diagnostics.

Warning solve-required-physical-inputs (SOLVE_BLOCKING, blocking) is raised when mechanics is incomplete or any diagnostic is blocking: mechanics solve-required data is incomplete; both solve and rule-check are blocked.

Warning rule-check-required-inputs (RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING) is raised when rule_check is incomplete: user-rule required inputs are absent so rule-check pass/fail and ratios stay blocked; private rule-pack criteria required.

Warning component-modifier-provenance (PROVENANCE_WARNING) is raised when component provenance includes no_flexibility_factor: component SIF or flexibility-factor provenance is absent; keep modifiers user-supplied, do not infer protected table values.

Warning code-combination-criteria-absent (RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING) is raised for load cases/combinations lacking code basis: load cases and combinations are mechanics inputs, not user-code rule combinations; supply private owner/code criteria.

Warning public-fixture-provenance-only (PROVENANCE_WARNING) is raised for invented public material/pipe-section fixtures: replace with user-controlled data and documented provenance before engineering reliance.

Warning professional-acceptance-not-provided (ASSUMPTION_WARNING) is raised when acceptance is not_provided: no hash-bound human acceptance record is attached; treat outputs as review context until human authority records acceptance outside the software.
isRuleIncomplete(status) returns true when the rule-check status contains incomplete, missing, or not_performed.
guiWarningClassStatusMap() maps each GUI warning class to its associated analysis-status tokens, all including HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
professionalBoundary() declares human_review_required=true with all compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication claim flags false.
ModelTree Props: model PreviewModel, current selection EntityRef, and onSelect(selection) callback.
ModelTree(model, selection, onSelect) renders the model entity tree with a filter, a project button, and grouped entity buttons; shows an empty message when the filter matches nothing.
Type TreeItem describes a tree node with id, type, label, optional detail, icon, and keywords; TreeModel/FilteredTreeModel hold the project, groups, and count.
TreeControls renders the model-tree filter input, a count summary ('N of M model entities visible'), and a clear-filter button.

buildTree(model) builds the tree with a project root and groups for Materials, Sections, Nodes, Pipe Segments, Supports, Components, Load Cases, and Combinations, each item carrying searchable keywords.
Empty groups are filtered out, and the tree count is 1 (project) plus the total number of grouped items.
provenanceKeyword(provenance) returns the string provenance directly or JSON-stringifies an object provenance.
filterTree(tree, filterText) returns the full tree for an empty query, otherwise keeps the project and group items whose keywords match the lowercased query.
matchesTreeItem(item, groupTitle, query) joins the item keywords, type, label, detail, and group title, lowercases them, and tests substring inclusion of the query.
TreeButton renders a selectable tree row with the item icon, label, optional detail, active styling, and aria-pressed state.
PropertyInspector(model, selection, onQueueIntent, onValidateIntent, ...) renders entity properties and review-only edit/create/delete operation intent panels for the selected model entity.
The inspector derives editable field options for the selection and holds local draft state for proposed value, unit, rationale, and section/material/support creation drafts.

buildOperationIntent is invoked for the selected field to produce a structured edit intent; section/material/support create intents and node/pipe/support delete intents are built when their drafts/selections are valid.
On mount the inspector loads the unit catalog via loadUnitCatalog(), falling back to route unavailable_browser_preview with a UNIT-CATALOG-LOAD-FAILED diagnostic on error.
handleQueueIntent queues the operation intent only when a field actually changed; create handlers queue the draft intent and advance the draft to the next reserved id.
When no editable entity is selected, the inspector prompts the user to select an editable model entity to draft a structured operation intent.

InlineValidationPreview shows structured-operation validation status (mode, application_status, schema/unit/before_state), a diff preview, and either a validate-only boundary note or per-diagnostic findings.
InlineValidationPreview boundary note states the intent is validate-only with no accepted model mutation and no professional approval.
Type EditableField describes an editable field's label, fieldPath, before value, objectType, changeKind (set_field|update_load|update_support), dimension, unit, sourceNote, and unitEditable.
Types SupportDraft, MaterialDraft, SectionDraft, and UnitOption define the local creation draft shapes and the unit option (symbol/label).
Constant RESTRAINT_OPTIONS = [UX, UY, UZ, RX, RY, RZ] enumerates the support restraint directions.
OperationIntentPreview renders intent facts: operation, target, change, unit basis, validation, audit boundary, professional boundary, and rationale.
IntentQueue lists queued transient editor intents (queue_id, operation_id, change path before-to-after, application_status, mutates_accepted_model_state) or an empty message.

unitOptions(route, dimensionId, fallbackSymbol) returns unit options from the tauri_unit_catalog filtered to the dimension, sorted canonical-first, always including the fallback; returns only the fallback when the catalog is unavailable.
unitEntryMatchesDimension matches a catalog entry to a dimension directly or via equivalentUnitDimensions.
equivalentUnitDimensions maps stress to pressure, displacement to length, rotation to angle, linear_stiffness to force_per_length, and volume_per_length to area.
unitCatalogStatus(route) reports the DEC-018 catalog loading state, the browser-preview no-fallback note, or the catalog decision basis, entry count, and storage convention.
editorFieldOptions(model, selection) returns the editable field list per entity type: material, node, pipe segment, support, component, load case, or combination.
Material editable fields include elastic_modulus and shear_modulus as stress quantities and thermal_expansion_coefficient, each with editable units.
Node editable fields are position.x/y/z as length quantities (default unit from project units length) plus label and provenance.
Pipe editable fields are section.outside_diameter and section.wall_thickness as length quantities, plus material reference and provenance.
scalarField(...) builds a non-unit-editable EditableField; quantityField(...) builds a unit-bearing EditableField with sourceNote 'unit metadata required'.

buildOperationIntent(field, model, proposedValue, proposedUnit, rationale, selection) builds an EditorOperationIntent of kind modify; for unit-editable fields the after value is a JSON {value, unit} payload.

Edit intent validation starts not_run/not_generated/not_applied; audit_boundary sets mutation_route=structured_operations_only, direct_model_mutation_allowed=false, requires_user_acceptance=true, mutates_accepted_model_state=false.
parseQuantityPayloadValue(raw) returns TBD for empty input, the numeric value when finite, otherwise the trimmed string.

buildCreateSectionIntent(draft, model) builds a create_section EditorOperationIntent with outside_diameter and wall_thickness quantities in the draft length unit; rationale requires service validation before durable model change.
buildCreateMaterialIntent(draft, model) builds a create_material intent with elastic_modulus and shear_modulus in the stress unit and optional thermal_expansion_coefficient; entered units preserved.
buildCreateSupportIntent(draft, model) builds a create_support intent capturing explicit user-entered support node and restraint tokens.
buildDeleteSupportIntent builds a delete_support intent requiring reference integrity validation before a durable model change.
buildDeleteNodeIntent builds a delete_node intent recording the node label and position, requiring endpoint and load reference integrity.
buildDeletePipeIntent builds a delete_pipe_run intent recording the pipe label, endpoints, and material, requiring primitive-load reference integrity.

matchingInlineValidationOutcome matches a validation outcome to an intent by operation_id, change_id, target ref/type, and change_kind, and validates the diff preview rows correspond to the intended change.
defaultSectionDraft/defaultMaterialDraft/defaultSupportDraft build creation drafts with the next reserved entity id, default units from the model, and provenance user_entered_local_preview.
nextSupportId/nextMaterialId/nextSectionId scan existing entities and queued create intents to find the next unreserved id (support:S-N, material:M-N, section:S-N).
isSectionDraftValid requires non-empty id/name/provenance, sectionType=pipe, a defined length unit, positive OD and wall thickness with wall < OD/2, and a unique section id.
isMaterialDraftValid requires non-empty id/label/provenance, a defined stress unit, positive elastic and shear moduli, valid thermal expansion when provided, and a unique material id.
isSupportDraftValid requires non-empty id/label/node/provenance, an existing target node, at least one valid restraint from RESTRAINT_OPTIONS, and a unique support id.
stressUnit(model) derives the stress unit from project units.pressure; thermalExpansionUnit derives 1/temperature; both fall back to TBD.
isPositiveInput(value) is true when the value is finite and greater than zero; isFiniteInput requires a non-empty finite number.
defaultSelection(model) returns a project EntityRef pointing at the model project id.
entityLabel(model, id) resolves the display label for any entity id across materials, sections, nodes, pipe segments, supports, components, load cases, and combinations, falling back to the id.
selectedProperties(model, selection) returns the label/value property pairs to display for the selected entity, dispatched by selection type.
Project properties are Project ID, Schema version, Mechanics status, Rule check status, and Professional acceptance status.
Material properties are ID, Elastic modulus, Shear modulus, Thermal expansion (or TBD), and Provenance, each formatted with value and unit.
Pipe properties are ID, From/To nodes, OD, Wall thickness, Material, and Provenance.
Load case properties are ID, Kind, Status, Load records count, primitive load Categories, Targets, and Provenance.
quantityDisplay formats a {value, unit} quantity or returns TBD; provenanceDisplay returns string provenance or JSON for objects.
primitiveLoadCategories and primitiveLoadTargets summarize a load case's primitive loads; formatPrimitiveLoadTarget renders type:node or type:pipe, defaulting to target:TBD.
stringField/optionalStringField safely read string record fields, returning TBD or null for missing/blank values.
NativePackagePanel Props include analysisRun, editorIntents, model, modelHash, projectSummary, proposal, result, selectedReviewTarget, and storageCapability.
Type UnitPreservationWitness records a source/target ref and quantity pair with conversion_performed=false and preservation_status=unit_and_value_preserved.
NativePackagePanel renders the native JSON package review when result and analysisRun exist, computes a package hash via usePackageHash, and exposes an Export JSON download link.

When no packet exists, the panel prompts running the mechanics preview to assemble a native JSON package review manifest with stable IDs, loss report, validation report, and local-only export boundaries.
buildNativePackageReview(...) assembles the native JSON package review document from entity refs, result refs, operation refs, diagnostics, and unit preservation evidence.

The package manifest member inventory lists deterministic-path members: manifest.json, model/project.json, maps/stable_id_map.json, reports/loss_report.json, reports/validation_report.json, diagnostics, runs, results, unit witnesses, and pending operations.
The native package document_kind is openpipestress.technical_preview.native_json_package_review with deliverable and package refs (DEL-17-02/03, etc.) and export_scope local_browser_download_preview.

export_profile native_open_json_preview preserves explicit units, requires a unit-witness sidecar for native JSON quantity fields, preserves source coordinates, uses a sidecar stable ID map, and mandates the loss report; physical container and public transport remain TBD.

The manifest declares deterministic_hash_basis JCS-compatible JSON, excludes runtime timestamps from hash inputs, and notes no protected standards, private rule payload, or release/compliance/acceptance claim is bundled.
loss_report uses categories exported, omitted, approximated, delegated, unsupported, and tbd; target-specific adapter behavior is unsupported and physical container / transport protocol are tbd.
validation_report covers package shape, deterministic member paths/ordering, model hash status, protected-content and private-payload screening, and asserts release_or_professional_claim=false.
generation_context records the local storage engine, network/daemon/telemetry flags, persisted review-context counts, repository_default_private_write=false, and runtime_timestamp_omitted=true.
buildUnitPreservationEvidence(model, result) collects model and result quantity witnesses preserving each quantity's value and unit without conversion.
Model unit witnesses are emitted for material elastic_modulus, shear_modulus, optional thermal_expansion_coefficient, pipe section quantities, and load-case primitive-load magnitudes.
Result unit witnesses are emitted for summary max_displacement and max_open_formula_stress and for each result row value/unit.

Unit preservation declares unit_system_ref unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display, preservation_policy that native open JSON preserves source quantity value and unit fields, and conversion_performed=false.

unitPreservationWitness(...) builds a witness with identical rounded source and target quantities, conversion_performed=false, basis_refs DEC-018/DEL-02-02/DEL-17-03, and a browser-preview provenance note.
withPackageHash(packet, packageHash) augments the validation report with package_hash_status computed_local_preview_sha256 or a TBD when the canonical package hash service is unavailable.
modelEntityRefs(model) collects and sorts all entity ids (project, materials, nodes, pipe segments, supports, components, load cases, combinations).
operationReviewRefs collects sorted review-only refs from editor intent queue/operation ids plus the proposal operation id.
quantityRecord(value) returns a {value, unit} record only when value is a numeric value with a string unit, otherwise null.
runHashStatus returns the analysis-run hash ref count or a sha256:<value> for a given payload scope, TBD when not available.

nativePackageBoundary(packet) returns a local-review-only boundary statement only when no private payload, protected content, release/compatibility/compliance claim, or professional approval claim is present.
round(value) rounds a number to 6 decimal places for deterministic witness quantities.
OperationApplyPanel(queuedIntents, outcomes, appliedOperations, undoCount, redoCount, busy, message, engineStatus, onValidate, onApply, onUndo, onRedo) renders the apply-structured-operations panel.
Panel summary: applying validates through the structured-operation seam and replaces the session model document; saving the project stores it locally.
The panel provides session edit history Undo/Redo controls disabled when busy or counts are zero, with a summary noting local_session_only=true and saved_project_mutated=false.
Each queued intent row shows the operation id, target and change, and Validate / Apply buttons; Validate validates without applying, Apply validates and applies to the session model.
The applied-operations ledger lists each receipt's operation id, target/change, application route, acceptance basis, persistence status, professional_approval flag, and short model hash.

Panel note: applying a structured operation records a user-initiated local-session acceptance only; it is not professional approval, certification, sealing, authentication, or a code-compliance claim, and earlier solve results are cleared because they no longer describe the edited model.
OutcomeSummary renders an operation outcome's mode, application/schema/unit/before_state validation, application route, diff preview rows, and per-diagnostic findings.
intentKey(intent) returns the intent queue_id or operation_id; shortHash truncates long hash strings to 24 characters with an ellipsis.
